Device remains active and approved in source/fhir.ini, and the latest combined branch contains only the corrected GMDN agency URL in current Device source.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current build-scoped core source already has the corrected GMDN link and does not contain the old Info.aspx pageid URL that now returns 404.
